summary: A platform-preempt's failure class reaches the prior-attempt record alone, so the verdict a supervisor reads carries no signature for the platform stage the section names

per.section: Repeated identical failures — quarantine, then abort

acceptance: an agent that failed for non-work reasons leaves a platform-stage failure record on the tick verdict — the preempt class as its signature, blamed on no entry — under either leg, and reported on the surfaces the render/merge/gate records already reach. Every other verdict field decodes as today, so the standing verdict and handoff tests stay green unchanged.

a wave preempted by a platform failure records a platform failure blamed on no entry
